intended_object: The standard generator 1 (mod n) of the cyclic group ℤ/nℤ, viewed as a finite (discrete) profinite additive group `finiteCyclic n`. Inferred from the docstring and the companion theorem `finiteCyclicGenerator_isTopologicalGenerator`.
explanation: `finiteCyclic n` is `ofFiniteAddGrp (FiniteAddGrp.of (ZMod n))`, so its underlying type is `ZMod n`. The body `show ZMod n from 1` picks out the residue class of 1, which is the standard generator of ℤ/nℤ. In the degenerate case n = 1, `1 = 0` in the trivial group, which still generates it. The library proves right after that this element is a topological generator. This is a specific element of a specific group, so generality is not an issue, and it mirrors the multiplicative version `ProfiniteGrp.finiteCyclicGenerator`.
